job.draft:
Hi Appkeeper team,

I'm applying for the Frontend Developer role. I have 4+ years of React experience and 4 years with TypeScript and Next.js. I currently lead engineering at Tututor.ai / EduNova, building web and mobile products and working directly with the founder on delivery.

Your focus on complex dashboards and real-time data fits my work. For Illume, I built AI analytics dashboards using Chart.js and D3.js, with integrations for revenue, bookings and retention data. At Danzee Tech, I built reusable React components and hooks and reduced Jurri's initial load time by approximately 40% through code splitting, lazy loading and bundle optimization. I also bring hands-on experience with REST APIs, WebSockets, Redux Toolkit, Jest, React Testing Library and Cypress.

I'm based in Pakistan, have advanced spoken and written English, and am available immediately. My portfolio is at https://itsubaidullahomer.com, and my GitHub is https://github.com/itsubaidullahomer.

Best,
Ubaidullah Omer
